lens: Interaction and responsive accessibility. All 14 account crops reviewed. Scores concern visible presentation only; keyboard behavior, accessible names, hit areas, and measured contrast are unverified. Outer padding is excluded. Visible data and status are preserved across each pair.

Colour both 8: brighten the muted 'Weekly Remaining' and loaded/eligible text slightly against the dark background; preserve amber warnings.
Controls/states both 8: strengthen the visible disclosure affordance around each account chevron, for example with a subtle bounded control treatment.
